sentences.en: Atlas is often depicted carrying the Earth on his shoulders.
sentences.zh: 1. 阿特拉斯常常被描绘成肩扛地球的形象。

sentences.en: The Tell Atlas separates northern Algeria from its high plateaus.
sentences.zh: 2. 塔勒阿特拉斯山将北部阿尔及利亚与其高原地区隔开。

sentences.en: The Atlantic Ocean derives its name from the Greek god Atlas.
sentences.zh: 3. 大西洋的名字来源于希腊神阿特拉斯。

senses.zh: 地图集,〈比喻〉身负重担的人
